source.defect: R09 checks a source part's pathname right after its own read; another writer can replace already-checked source_00.part while SourceLock scans later parts or all ZIP members. Identical bytes at a different inode pass the combined hash but the final path is no longer the verified one.
source.fix: Record original pathname and descriptor identity for all three source parts, then re-lstat all input paths after scanning every ZIP member and before returning a SourceLock evidence receipt. Reject replaced, missing, non-regular, or Windows reparse files.
source.limit: Not an OS-level immutable read-only snapshot: uncooperative writers can still race after the final check. Physical original ZIP 729 SHA has not been run.
